description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CACI International Inc. is seeking an ArcGIS Developer to support the Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS) program. The role develops and maintains geospatial applications, data, and analytical tools that support transportation and logistics visualization, situational awareness, and decision-making.
ArcGIS Developer developing web mapping applications, managing geospatial data and services, and integrating JTMS for analysis

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain web-based mapping applications using ArcGIS JavaScript API, Web AppBuilder, and Experience Builder
• Create and manage geospatial data, feature services, and map services in ArcGIS Enterprise environments
• Support the integration of JTMS data with ArcGIS platforms for visualization and analysis
• Perform quality assurance and testing of GIS applications and data
• Assist in the development of custom geoprocessing tools and workflows
• Provide technical documentation for developed applications and processes
• Collaborate with senior developers, system administrators, and end-users to gather requirements and deliver solutions
• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to GIS applications and services
• Stay current with ArcGIS platform updates and emerging geospatial technologies

Requirements:
• Active Secret Clearance
• Bachelor's degree in Geography, Geographic Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
• 1-2 years of experience with ArcGIS Desktop, ArcGIS Pro, or ArcGIS Online
• Basic understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise architecture and components
• Familiarity with web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• Knowledge of geospatial data formats and coordinate systems
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment

Preferred:
• Experience with ArcGIS JavaScript API or Python for ArcGIS
• Knowledge of REST APIs and web services
• Familiarity with SQL and database concepts
• Working knowledge and experience with SAP S4 HANA
• Agile SAFe experience
• Understanding of transportation or logistics systems
• ESRI Technical Certification
